text.p: Diversifed marine conglomerate, SembCorp, said on Friday 182 million stg of claims made by Allseas were adjudged by a London arbitration panel to be claims properly excluded by the vessel conversion contract.
The case stems from the conversion contract for the vessel "Solitaire" at the Sembawang Shipyard.

Allseas, the owners, have alleged defects in the vessel and claimed damages for indirect losses, loss of revenue, loss of use, loss of profit or anticipated profit due to the alleged delay in delivery by SembCorp.

SembCorp said in a statement that it had applied at an early stage in the arbitration proceedings to strike out the major part of Allseas claims on the basis that such claims were excluded from the contract.
The SembCorp statement said the company was not in a position to evaluate the final likely outcome or provide any realistic estimate of the potential exposure, if any.
No provisions have been made in respect to this litigation, it added.
